rom.requirements: PAL A500, 68000, OCS 8371/8362, 512 KiB Chip + 512 KiB slow RAM, one DD/HD drive; read-only DF0 floppy boot or an owned writable CopperOS DOS1 workspace. Optional existing hard disk image on unit 0: RDB-discovered FFS/DOS1 partitions or one explicit 512-byte FFS partition, including TD64 offsets above 4 GiB. RDB boot priorities select SYS:. No RTC, Fast RAM or shared folders.
rom.producerSourceSnapshot: Recorded dos-large-rom-20261019 Classic producer snapshot: native ACTION_SEEK64, unsigned file positions, classic-seek fallback, shared MODE_OLDFILE writes with protection retained, aligned internal copies, bitmap cache spans and buffered range flushing with partial-progress retention. Complete native write replies ignore undefined secondary errors. Core 493878 bytes; graphics 30099 bytes at $FF8A00. TD64 retained; no NSD changes.

producerInputs.scope: PAL OCS A500, 68000, 512 KiB chip and slow; DOS large-file seeks, shared MODE_OLDFILE writes, bitmap/cache traversal and aligned block copies; buffered range flushing with retained suffixes; TD64; no NSD changes

limits: Short overwrites of existing fully allocated sparse files; no multi-GiB streaming or file-format widening.
Frozen Classic producer snapshot plus recorded corrections; concurrent DOS/Exec/SFS work excluded.
Source app/runtime and runner qualification, not an installed-package release.
Writes still validate the full existing pointer chain, so short overwrites of very large files remain expensive on the emulated 68000.
